rationale: The reviewer found the GC-content confound (bacteria ~0.55 vs phage ~0.41, no overlap) and showed that GC alone, and k-mer logistic regression, both reach 1.0 test accuracy, so the model's 0.99 is no better than a composition baseline. They also proposed reporting GC/k-mer baselines, and they validly noted that the attention-map claim about structural and replication genes has no supporting evidence or code.
